caption: The drawing depicts a dress composed of two main parts: an outer gown and an underdress. The outer gown is primarily cream or off-white in color, adorned with intricate yellow and gold floral patterns covering the whole surface, including the wide skirt and the fitted bodice. The dress has elbow-length sleeves finished with decorative cuffs. The bodice features a V-shaped neckline and is edged with gold details, also partially revealing an inner garment with a multicolored floral pattern near the neckline. The underdress, visible from the waist down and in the bodice's opening, is a medium to light blue color with a quilted texture and an embossed design of leaves and flowers. The composition is centered, with the dress occupying most of the image space and no background elements or additional objects present. The entire illustration is set against a plain, light-beige background.
title: Dress
